title: Toward Independent Imani Growth: Accompanying Your Young Adult at Life’s Threshold (16-18 Years)
description: A pathway to help parents guide their child from inherited iman to firmly rooted conviction, while preparing for marriage and upholding `iffah (chastity) through open dialogue. It focuses on crafting a life mission that connects ambition with purpose, and independence with decision-making and responsibility—before leaving home.

primary_reference.info: تربية الأولاد في الإسلام لعبد الله ناصح علوان + منهج التربية النبوية للطفل لمحمد نور سويد

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'رشد' means maturity, right guidance, or reaching sound judgment, not simply 'growth'. The translation loses the specific nuance of attaining mature, guided faith.

The Arabic uses the masculine singular 'شابك' (your young man), while the English uses the gender-neutral 'young adult'. The description later confirms the resource is for a son ('ابنهم'), so the gender specificity is lost.

review_defects.arabic: نقل ابنهم من إيمانٍ موروث إلى إيمانٍ راسخٍ بقناعة
review_defects.english: guide their child from inherited iman to firmly rooted conviction
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'نقل' (transfer) is stronger than 'guide'; 'ابنهم' (their son) is changed to 'their child'; and 'إيمانٍ راسخٍ بقناعة' (firmly rooted faith with conviction) is reduced to 'firmly rooted conviction', omitting the word 'faith' and merging two distinct concepts.
The Arabic says 'preparing for marriage and chastity', while the English adds 'upholding', which is not present in the source and slightly shifts the meaning.
